verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a case management solution where analysts review alerts and record a case decision ('no risk detected', 'risk detected – accepted', 'risk detected – offboard'), either in the web app or via the API. That is a thin form of recording an investigation outcome. Nothing in the evidence shows free-text notes, evidence attachments, written decision reasons, or a viewable investigation history or audit trail. missing for 10: free-text notes on cases, evidence/document attachments, recorded decision rationale, investigation history/audit log, independent corroboration.
